i2c_mpu6050.implementation: hardware STM32F0 I2C with blocking flag polling
i2c_mpu6050.derivation: write address + register + repeated-start read address + 14 data bytes; 9 SCL clocks per byte
i2c_mpu6050.cpu_behavior: polls I2C flags while the transfer progresses; this is external wait behavior and is excluded from CPU static scores

xn297_bayang.cpu_behavior: GPIO bit-banging executes on the CPU; packet reads and telemetry writes are conditional
xn297_bayang.separation: reported as peripheral/polling work, never converted into simulated flight-math timing
